name: Full Stack Web Development
description: Learn full stack development in Jaipur across frontend, backend, databases and deployment with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, SQL and MongoDB at Groot Academy.
intro: Build complete web applications from responsive interfaces to backend services, databases and deployment. This broad full-stack path is intentionally stack-neutral: it teaches how frontend and backend pieces connect, while the dedicated MERN course focuses specifically on MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js.
audience: Students, graduates and career changers who want a broad web development foundation. Start with basic computer skills and practise coding regularly.
modules: Responsive web foundations
Structure pages with HTML, style layouts with CSS and build interfaces that work across screen sizes.
JavaScript development
Work with functions, objects, browser events and asynchronous requests before moving into application frameworks.
Frontend applications
Build reusable React components and connect screens through routing, state and API requests. Discuss Angular as another frontend learning path.
Server-side development
Use Node.js to handle requests, organise application logic and connect frontend actions to backend services.
Databases
Model application data, practise SQL queries and compare relational storage with MongoDB documents.
Application delivery
Use Linux foundations and deployment workflows to bring the interface, server and database together.
projects: Build a small catalogue with searchable records, a backend API and persistent data.
Present your application, explain the data flow and document how to run it.
faq: How is Full Stack Development different from MERN?

Full Stack Development is the broader frontend-to-backend learning path and can include multiple database or backend approaches. MERN is a specific JavaScript stack built around MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js.
Does this course cover both frontend and backend development?
Yes. The learning path connects HTML, CSS and JavaScript with React, server-side development, databases and deployment so learners can understand a complete application workflow.

name: MERN Stack Development
description: Learn MERN Stack development in Jaipur with JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, APIs and integrated application projects at Groot Academy.
intro: Build JavaScript applications with the MERN stack: MongoDB for data, Express and Node.js for backend services, and React for the interface. This page targets MERN-specific training rather than the broader Full Stack Development path, helping searchers choose the exact stack they want to learn.
audience: Learners with basic HTML, CSS and programming familiarity who want to build JavaScript applications. Strengthen JavaScript fundamentals before progressing to React and Node.js.
modules: JavaScript and TypeScript foundations
Review ES5 and ES6 syntax, functions, objects and modules, with an introduction to TypeScript.
React interfaces
Work with components, lifecycle concepts, hooks, events, local storage and React Router.
Application state and testing
Manage shared state with Redux, make network calls and test React application behaviour.
Node.js services
Explore modules, events, streams, the file system and HTTP request handling.
Express APIs
Create routes and middleware, organise services and review security considerations for backend applications.
MongoDB and Mongoose
Perform CRUD operations, design document models and use Mongoose to connect application code to data.
Integrated deployment
Connect the React frontend to the API and database, then practise application deployment.
projects: Build a React interface backed by Express endpoints and MongoDB records.
Add routing, loading states and error handling to a dashboard that reads and updates data.
faq: MERN stands for MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js. Together they cover the database, backend services and user interface of a modern JavaScript application.
Should I choose MERN or the broader Full Stack Development course?

Choose MERN when you specifically want the MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js stack. Choose the broader Full Stack Development path when you want a wider frontend-to-backend foundation that is not limited to one stack.

name: Python Programming
description: Learn Python programming in Jaipur from beginner syntax and problem solving to functions, data structures, object-oriented programming, files and practical automation at Groot Academy.
intro: Start with Python programming fundamentals and learn to turn problems into clear, working code. Practise control flow, functions, collections, files, debugging and object-oriented programming, then use those foundations for small applications and automation without turning this page into a Data Science course.
audience: Beginners, students and working professionals who want programming skills. No prior programming experience is needed to begin with the foundations.
modules: Programming foundations
Understand variables, data types, expressions and readable Python syntax.
Control flow and collections
Use conditions, loops, strings and collection types to organise and process information.
Functions and reusable code
Break tasks into functions, use modules and explore Python's standard library.
Object-oriented programming
Represent concepts with classes and objects and organise related behaviour into reusable components.
Files and debugging
Read and write files, handle errors and practise finding and fixing program defects.
Practical applications
Apply Python to scripting and automation, and explore how it supports web development, data analysis and machine learning.
projects: Read a structured file, validate its contents and produce a useful summary.
Write a reusable script for a repetitive task and document its inputs and error cases.
faq: Is this Python course suitable for beginners?
Yes. The course starts with programming foundations and does not require prior coding experience, although regular practice is important.
Is this the same as a Data Science course?

No. This page focuses on Python programming. Data Science adds statistics, data preparation, visualisation and machine-learning methods; learners interested in that path should continue to the dedicated Data Science and Machine Learning course.

name: Java Programming & Backend Development
description: Learn Java programming in Jaipur with Core Java foundations, object-oriented programming, JDBC, Spring Boot, REST APIs and backend development at Groot Academy.
intro: Build a strong Java programming foundation first, then progress into backend development with JDBC, Spring and Spring Boot. The page consolidates broad Java and Core Java search intent while showing the later backend path without creating separate duplicate pages for every Java subtopic.
audience: Students and aspiring backend developers. Begin with Java basics; the backend modules build on programming and object-oriented concepts.
modules: Java foundations
Practise Java syntax, data types, control structures and core programming concepts.
Backend and web foundations
Understand backend responsibilities, HTTP requests, Java Servlets and JavaServer Pages.
Database access with JDBC
Connect Java code to a relational database and perform database operations.
Spring and Spring Boot
Introduce the Spring framework and build RESTful web services with Spring Boot.
Persistence with JPA
Use Spring Data JPA to model and persist application data.
Application quality
Review authentication and authorisation, error handling, logging and backend testing.
projects: Build a small record-management application with a database-backed workflow.
Create and test API endpoints, persist records and handle invalid requests clearly.
faq: Does this course include Core Java?
Yes. The learning path begins with Java syntax, object-oriented programming and core concepts before moving into database and backend topics.
Does the Java course also cover Spring Boot and backend development?
The path progresses from Java foundations into JDBC, Spring Boot, REST services and JPA. Confirm the exact module coverage for the selected batch with the course team.
